item.title: Swarms Team Compiles Research List for Multi-Agent Systems
item.description:
Swarms Team Compiles Research List for Multi-Agent Systems

The Swarms Team, whose mission is to research multi-agent systems, has compiled a list of research papers focused on the best multi-agent research.

🔍 Overview

The compiled list covers a wide range of multi-agent research developments, including:

Paper Title Focus/Topic
AutoGen Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation
AIOS LLM Agent Operating System
AgentScope A Flexible yet Robust Multi-Agent Platform
LongAgent Scaling Language Models to 128k Context through Multi-Agent Collaboration
Mixture-of-Agents Enhances Large Language Model Capabilities
EvoAgent Towards Automatic Multi-Agent Generation via Evolutionary Algorithms
Internet of Agents Weaving a Web of Heterogeneous Agents for Collaborative Intelligence
SwarmAgentic Towards Fully Automated Agentic System Generation via Swarm Intelligence
AGENTSNET Coordination and Collaborative Reasoning in Multi-Agent LLMs
LLM Economist Large Population Models and Mechanism Design in Multi-Agent Generative Simulacra
Federation of Agents A Semantics-Aware Communication Fabric for Large-Scale Agentic AI
MAS-Zero Designing Multi-Agent Systems with Zero Supervision
SOTOPIA-RL Reward Design for Social Intelligence
Talk Isn’t Always Cheap Understanding Failure Modes in Multi-Agent Debate
Virtual Agent Economies Agent Economies
Chain of Agents Large Language Models Collaborating on Long-Context Tasks
LLM-Agent-UMF LLM-based Agent Unified Modeling Framework
Optima Optimizing Effectiveness and Efficiency for LLM-Based Multi-Agent System
K-Level Reasoning with Large Language Models Reasoning with LLMs
More Agents is All You Need Multi-agent research
Learning to Decode Collaboratively with Multiple Language Models Collaborative decoding
Large Language Model Cascades with Mixture of Thoughts Representations Cost-efficient Reasoning
Optimizing Collaboration of LLM based Agents Agent collaboration optimization
Thought Communication in Multiagent Collaboration Multiagent collaboration communication

#MultiAgentSystems #LLM #AIResearch #Swarms
